text: DSH Service Console 是面向 DSH Web 的本地开发服务控制台，可扫描本机 TCP 监听端口，并关联进程、命令、工作目录与会话或工作区归属。它通过 DSH Web 面板和设置页展示服务，也提供只读的 service_list 工具。用户可以搜索和查看服务详情、调整刷新与停止选项，并对可操作的服务执行优雅停止或基于会话启动记录重启。适合需要查看本机开发服务器端口和进程状态的 DSH 用户；需要 macOS 或 Linux，不需要额外账号或 API 密钥。

DSH Service Console scans local TCP listeners and shows process and workspace details in a DSH web panel. Search and inspect services, stop eligible processes, or restart those with recorded launch commands. A read-only tool lists services. For macOS or Linux.
想在 DSH 里查看当前机器有哪些开发服务器正在监听端口。
帮我把本机各个服务的端口和对应进程整理出来。
如何确认某个监听端口属于当前工作区启动的服务？
想从 DSH 面板搜索并查看本地服务的命令和工作目录。
DSH 能不能列出我正在运行的 Vite 或其他开发服务？
我想从控制台优雅地停止一个本地开发进程。
有办法根据之前记录的启动命令重新启动开发服务吗？
Show me which development services are listening on ports on this machine.
I want to inspect the process and working directory behind a local server.
Can I see which local services belong to my current workspace?
Help me find and gracefully stop a development server from the DSH web UI.
DSH Service Console 的功能「扫描监听服务」：发现本机正在监听的 TCP 端口，并读取对应进程、命令、工作目录和启动信息。打开面板获取快照，用户可主动刷新。
DSH Service Console 的功能「识别服务归属」：将服务与会话启动台账、工作区路径匹配，并显示会话确认、工作区推断、本机其他、未知或受保护等归属状态。
DSH Service Console 的功能「停止服务」：从面板对选中的可操作服务发起停止，先向进程组发送 SIGTERM 并等待其退出；只有设置允许时才会在超时后强制终止。
DSH Service Console 的功能「重启服务」：对有会话启动记录且可重启的服务，先执行停止，再用记录的工作目录和命令重新启动；缺少记录时返回不可重启结果。
DSH Service Console 的功能「service_list」：模型可按服务名、PID、命令、工作目录或端口筛选本机服务列表，并设置返回数量；该工具只读。

@jiyr0119/dsh-service-console README · DSH Service Console：> A local development service console for DSH: discover listening ports, identify services related to the current conversation or workspace, and safely inspect, stop, or restart them.

@jiyr0119/dsh-service-console README · DSH Service Console：Single-purpose plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI. When the model (or you) starts a local dev server (`npm run dev`, Vite, Next.js, Uvicorn, Express, Rust, …), Service Console shows it in one place: which ports it listens on, which command and working directory started it, whether it belongs to this conversation or workspace, and whether it is safe to stop or restart.

@jiyr0119/dsh-service-console README · Features：- **Discovery** — scans listening TCP ports and correlates PID, PPID, command, working directory, process group and start time (macOS/Linux).
- **Ownership & risk** — five-level attribution: `This chat` (matched against the session launch ledger), `Workspace`, `Other local`, `Unknown`, `Protected`.
- **Control** — graceful stop to the process group, restart with a safe saved launch command. Every action is confirmed twice and re-validated against the current snapshot.
- **Safeguards** — PID-reuse / fingerprint checks before any signal; unknown and protected services are read-only; force-kill is off by default; no implicit auto-cleanup; command output is redacted.
- **All local services** — every listening service on this machine is visible; ownership is shown as a safety signal rather than a hidden category filter.
- **Search, config, i18n** — keyword filtering, graceful timeout / force-kill settings, and automatic Chinese/English labels from DSH's active locale.
- **On-demand scanning** — opening the console fetches the current snapshot once; use the refresh button for an explicit rescan. There is no background polling.

@jiyr0119/dsh-service-console README · Install：Native package (recommended):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add -w @jiyr0119/dsh-service-console@latest
```

Then refresh the DSH web UI — a `🖥 SC` entry appears in the conversation header and opens the console panel.

> Note: a plugin being listed in dsh-market/awesome does not mean its UI auto-appears — this package ships both Host routes and a browser bundle, so after `dsh plugin add` the panel is present. Works on macOS / Linux; Windows is not supported yet.
@jiyr0119/dsh-service-console README · Install：Alternative — dynamic paste (zero-build, process-local): paste `dynamic/host.js` + `dynamic/client.js` via the dynamic Cordis plugin flow.

@jiyr0119/dsh-service-console README · UI preview：The preview shows the complete local listening-service list and the expanded inspector card. The ownership badge remains visible as a safety signal, while the list itself is no longer split into conversation/workspace/machine categories.

**[→ Interactive Demo](./demo/index.html)** — try the Service Console UI in your browser (no installation required).

@jiyr0119/dsh-service-console README · Permissions & safety：- The client never sends raw PIDs or shell commands; it targets a service ID and the Host re-validates PID / start time / fingerprint before acting.
- Graceful termination first (SIGTERM to the process group); SIGKILL only when explicitly enabled and confirmed.
- Sensitive tokens/passwords in command summaries are redacted.
- This plugin is **not** a general process manager: system-critical, high-privilege, unknown and protected processes are read-only.

@jiyr0119/dsh-service-console README · Testing：`npm test` builds once and runs the whole suite with Node's built-in test runner (`node --test`). No extra test framework is required.

@jiyr0119/dsh-service-console README · Testing：| File | Type | What it covers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `test/process-inspector.test.mjs` | Unit | Platform output parsing (`parseLstart`, `parseListenRows`, `parsePsRows`, `parseAddress`), command redaction, five-level ownership classification |
| `test/host-more.test.mjs` | Unit | Config validation, session ledger, lifecycle state machine (stop/restart) with fake dependencies, service aggregation & fingerprint stability |
| `test/integration.test.mjs` | Integration | Real system commands + a temporary HTTP server spawned by the test itself; signals are only ever sent to test-owned processes |

@jiyr0119/dsh-service-console README · Testing：```bash
npm test                                   # full suite
npm run build && node --test test/process-inspector.test.mjs   # run a single file
```

Unit tests import the built output under `lib/`, so the sources must be compiled first — `npm test` handles this automatically.
